penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: A meaningful CI/build audit requires reading actual pipeline configs (GitHub Actions YAML, Dockerfile, package.json, etc.) and producing tailored recommendations — per-customer analysis that cannot be fully standardised without hands-on access to each codebase.

rationale: Engineering leads at Series A–C startups are a named buyer with real budget authority and genuine pain — CI bloat is a continuous, measurable cost in compute spend and developer time. Willingness to pay at $200–500/mo is plausible given existing tools like Trunk.io or BuildPulse. However, delivering actionable CI optimisation recommendations requires direct access to each customer's pipeline configuration and codebase context, making per-customer human fulfillment unavoidable at anything beyond a shallow checklist. Operational autonomy scores 5 and after the requires_human_fulfillment penalty the total drops to 4.2, below the validate threshold. Buildability with AI is also only moderate (5) — the hardest and most valuable part is codebase-specific diagnosis, not generic advice.
solution_plan: Not viable in current form for this factory. A truly useful CI optimisation service requires reading each customer's actual pipeline files and understanding their specific build graph — that's per-customer technical work that cannot be delegated to Claude prompts alone without codebase access integrations (GitHub App, CI provider APIs). The surface-level version (a generic checklist report) is buildable but would not differentiate from free blog posts and would not command $200+/mo. A solo non-technical operator cannot build the deeper integrations needed to make this genuinely valuable. Drop unless a fully self-serve, automated pipeline analyser can be scoped — revisit if a GitHub App integration path becomes feasible.
notes: After requires_human_fulfillment penalty, total falls to 4.2, below min_total_to_validate (5.5). Operational_autonomy (5) and buildability_with_ai (5) also both fall short of their respective build gate floors.
